nodes.description: Roles.Role _minters mapping tracking minter role bearers in MinterRole.
mapping(address=>uint256) _balances holding token balances in ERC20.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowed holding allowances in ERC20.
uint256 _totalSupply total minted token supply in ERC20.
string _name token name set in ERC20Detailed constructor.
string _symbol token symbol set in ERC20Detailed constructor.
uint8 _decimals token decimals set in ERC20Detailed constructor.
MinterRole constructor; adds msg.sender as the initial minter.
isMinter(address) public view returning whether account holds minter role.
addMinter(address) public onlyMinter granting minter role to account.
renounceMinter() public removing the caller's own minter role.
_addMinter(address) internal adding account to _minters via Roles.add.
_removeMinter(address) internal removing account from _minters via Roles.remove.
ERC20Mintable.mint(address,uint256) public onlyMinter minting tokens to recipient.
ERC20._mint(address,uint256) internal increasing totalSupply and balance via SafeMath.add.
ERC20._burn(address,uint256) internal reducing totalSupply and balance via SafeMath.sub.
ERC20._burnFrom(address,uint256) internal reducing allowance then burning.
ERC20._transfer(address,address,uint256) internal moving balances with SafeMath.sub/add.
ERC20.transfer(address,uint256) public sending from msg.sender via _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public spending allowance then transferring.
ERC20.approve(address,uint256) public setting allowance for spender by msg.sender.
ERC20.increaseAllowance(address,uint256) public adding to spender allowance.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance(address,uint256) public subtracting from spender allowance.
ERC20.balanceOf(address) public view returning _balances[owner].
ERC20.allowance(address,address) public view returning _allowed[owner][spender].
ERC20.totalSupply() public view returning _totalSupply.
NewLGO.bulkMint(address[],uint256[]) public looping over arrays calling mint.
NewLGO.bulkTransfer(address[],uint256[]) public looping over arrays calling transfer.
NewLGO constructor initializing ERC20Detailed with name/symbol/decimals.
ERC20Burnable.burn(uint256) public burning msg.sender tokens.
ERC20Burnable.burnFrom(address,uint256) public burning from target using allowance.
Roles.add(Role storage,address) internal granting a role bearer.
Roles.remove(Role storage,address) internal revoking a role bearer.
Roles.has(Role storage,address) internal view checking bearer status.
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256) internal pure with overflow require check.
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256) internal pure with underflow require check.
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256) internal pure with overflow require check.
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256) internal pure with divide-by-zero check.
SafeMath.mod(uint256,uint256) internal pure with zero check.
ERC20Detailed constructor writing _name,_symbol,_decimals.
ERC20Detailed.name() public view returning _name.
ERC20Detailed.symbol() public view returning _symbol.
ERC20Detailed.decimals() public view returning _decimals.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller used for authorization and ownership.
Arithmetic addition of minted value into totalSupply and balance inside _mint.
Arithmetic subtraction/addition of balances inside _transfer.
Unchecked loop counter increment i++ while iterating arrays in bulkMint.
Arithmetic subtraction of allowance inside transferFrom and _burnFrom.
address account parameter of isMinter/addMinter.
address to parameter, recipient in mint/transfer.
uint256 value parameter, amount in mint/transfer.
address[] accounts parameter in bulkMint/bulkTransfer.
uint256[] values parameter in bulkMint/bulkTransfer.
address spender parameter in approve/increaseAllowance.
address from parameter in transferFrom/burnFrom.
address owner parameter in balanceOf/allowance.
uint loop index i used in bulkMint/bulkTransfer for loops.

edges.reason: msg.sender is checked through isMinter(msg.sender) in the onlyMinter modifier.
renounceMinter removes the role of the caller msg.sender.
transfer sends tokens from msg.sender.
approve sets allowance owned by msg.sender.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender of allowance.
_burnFrom deducts from the allowance of msg.sender.
burn destroys tokens of the caller msg.sender.
MinterRole constructor passes msg.sender to _addMinter.
account parameter is granted the minter role in addMinter.
account parameter is checked for role membership in isMinter.
to parameter is the mint recipient.
value parameter is the amount minted.
accounts array drives the bulkMint loop iteration.
values array drives the bulkMint amounts.
spender parameter receives the allowance in approve.
from parameter is debited in transferFrom.
owner parameter indexes _balances in balanceOf.
bulkMint repeatedly calls mint, which enforces onlyMinter internally.
bulkTransfer repeatedly calls transfer in a loop.
mint delegates to internal _mint.
burn delegates to internal _burn.
burnFrom delegates to internal _burnFrom.
_burnFrom calls _burn after reducing allowance.
MinterRole constructor calls _addMinter for msg.sender.
_addMinter calls Roles.add to grant the role.
_removeMinter calls Roles.remove to revoke the role.
isMinter queries Roles.has for role membership.
transfer calls internal _transfer.
transferFrom calls internal _transfer after allowance deduction.
_mint uses SafeMath.add for totalSupply and balance updates.
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance.
_transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
_burn uses SafeMath.sub for supply and balance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
increaseAllowance uses SafeMath.add.
decreaseAllowance uses SafeMath.sub.
_burnFrom uses SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
ERC20Detailed constructor writes _name.
ERC20Detailed constructor writes _symbol.
ERC20Detailed constructor writes _decimals.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint increases the recipient balance in _balances.
_transfer updates both sender and recipient entries of _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_burn decreases the account balance in _balances.
approve writes the spender allowance into _allowed.
transferFrom decreases the allowance stored in _allowed.
increaseAllowance writes the increased allowance into _allowed.
decreaseAllowance writes the decreased allowance into _allowed.
_burnFrom decreases the allowance stored in _allowed.
_addMinter adds a bearer into the _minters role structure.
_removeMinter removes a bearer from the _minters role structure.
Roles.add sets role.bearer[account] to true.
Roles.remove sets role.bearer[account] to false.
Roles.has reads role.bearer[account].
balanceOf reads _balances[owner].
allowance reads _allowed[owner][spender].
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
name returns the stored _name.
symbol returns the stored _symbol.
decimals returns the stored _decimals.
_mint performs token amount addition that must not overflow.
_transfer performs balance subtraction and addition.
bulkMint increments the loop counter i without an explicit bound check.
transferFrom subtracts the spent value from the allowance.
_burnFrom subtracts the burned value from the allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: The account parameter only flows into addMinter and isMinter role handling.
The to parameter is the recipient used by the mint entry point.
The value parameter is the minted amount consumed by mint.
The accounts array is iterated directly inside bulkMint.
The values array is indexed directly inside bulkMint.
The spender parameter is written into the allowance by approve.
The from parameter is debited inside transferFrom.
The owner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The loop counter i exists only within the bulkMint iteration.
